description: Searches Google web results and returns up to 20 organic results (title, url, snippet, position) for a query, localized by country and language; page gives later results. Use it to find pages and sources. It does not return page contents (use scrape_url on a result url), ads or other result blocks, and is not for news, products or local places (use search_news, google_shopping_prices or google_maps_places). Required: query.

country.description: Two-letter country code that localizes results, e.g. "it" for Italy or "gb" for the United Kingdom. Omit for the source default, us.

language.description: Two-letter language code for the results, e.g. "en" or "it". Omit for the source default, en.

page.description: Zero-based results page, integer 0-100: 0 is the first page, 1 the second, e.g. 1. Omit for the first page; each page is a separate charged call.

query.description: Search text, 1-500 characters, e.g. "espresso machine reviews"; operators such as site:example.com work.

results.description: Maximum organic results returned, integer 1-20, default 10, e.g. 5.

name: google_search
title: Google Search
